title: A new Cities: Skylines Series: Franklin
description:
It's a new series where we follow the development of a city over time and stuff. We're gonna talk about urbanism and economics and social issues and all that crap.

Check out some early screenshots in the Simtropolis thread: https://community.simtropolis.com/forums/topic/75274-franklin/


Follow me on my Patreon to see the draft episodes early (there are two up already!): https://www.patreon.com/donoteat

and on my Twitter: https://twitter.com/donoteat1
